extracted.name: Basil Pecan Pesto
extracted.description: In this basil pecan pesto recipe, pecans replace the typical pine nuts, creating a fresh and delicious change-up to a familiar Ligurian pasta sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 pinch ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine basil, pecans, olive oil, Parmesan cheese, garlic, salt, and black pepper in the bowl of a food processor; pulse until blended.
